lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso (approx. 3-5% of total torso width per gap) and becomes more irregular towards the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The three posterior-most vertical markings are composed of discontinuous, abbreviated segments and dots rather than solid lines; the anterior-most line terminates approximately 60% of the way up the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 5-6 high-contrast white spots located on the lower haunch and upper hind limb with variable spatial density.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the mid-posterior haunch align to form a semi-horizontal geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: White V-shaped chevron between the eyes, dual white spots on the lower cheek, a prominent white crescent-shaped patch on the lower neck, and white horizontal banding on the interior of the upper legs.
